AI Mode replied:

You can factory reset your TP-Link router by following the official guidelines on the TP-Link Support Page. 
Physical Reset (Hard Reset)
  • Power on the router: Ensure the device is plugged into a working power outlet and turned on. 
  • Locate the button: Look at the back or front panel for a dedicated Reset button, a combined WPS/Reset button, or a small recessed pinhole. 
  • Press and hold: Hold the button down for more than 10 seconds (or about 2 to 10 seconds depending on the specific model) using your finger or a paperclip until the system LED changes from a slow flash to a quick flash. 
  • Wait for reboot: Release the button and let the router restart completely.
